kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اختفيت (form VIII)
# اِخْتَفَيْتُ (iḵtafaytu) /ix.ta.faj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اِخْتَفَيْتَ (iḵtafayta) /ix.ta.faj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اِخْتَفَيْتِ (iḵtafayti) /ix.ta.faj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اُخْتُفِيتُ (uḵtufītu) /ux.tu.fiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
